name: Traveler (Dendro)
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Deepwood Memories first, Burst > Skill > Normal Attack, an ER-first Sands (EM or ATK% after it), a Dendro DMG Goblet (EM for the pure-reaction build) and a CRIT Circlet. KQM adds Noblesse Oblige (Aggravate), Emblem of Severed Fate, Gilded Dreams, Flower of Paradise Lost and Instructor as fits for particular teams; Game8's second set is Gilded Dreams for its reaction build. Weapons differ in the lead: Game8 puts Freedom-Sworn first, KQM lists Favonius Sword, Sacrificial Sword and Skyward Blade first and Freedom-Sworn under other options; the list keeps Game8's first and KQM's after it. The Burst's Explosion (400.8% to 721.4%, elemental curve) is the damage line. ER is KQM's range by rotation (250-300 with one Skill solo Dendro, 200-250 with two Skills, 160-200 with a second Dendro unit); 200 is used for the usual two-Skill team. No source gives ATK or CRIT goals. Partners are inferred from the Aggravate, Bloom and Quicken teams KQM names.
